title: Women Worry, Men Adopt: How Gendered Perceptions Shape the Use of Generative AI
reasoning: The paper investigates how gendered adoption of Generative AI is driven by perceptions of societal and ethical risks, such as mental health and environmental harms. It evaluates the impact of 'moral sensitivity' and 'value-based differences' on technology use, identifying ethical concern—rather than skill or access—as a primary barrier for women.
